Mini world change in which the witch {npc:Wyda}, in the Green Claw Swamp, is bored. While it is active, you can hand her {item:Blood Herb|Blood Herbs} for a chance to receive a {item:Torn Teddy} (achievement **Torn Treasures**) and kill the fake giant spiders that appear around her house (achievement **Someone's Bored**).
Only while this mini world change is active on your world.
No Premium or minimum level needed (8 recommended).
as many as you want to hand in; each one is one attempt

for the cave's rope spot and to get out
Gather several {item:Blood Herb|Blood Herbs} before you go: the Torn Teddy is rare. In the wiki's statistics, out of 390 hand-ins there were 376 Witchesbroom and only 14 Torn Teddy.
1. Find out whether the world change is active

When the mini world change is active, one of these messages appears: *"Sharpen your sword! The witch Wyda seems to be bored so pay her a visit!"* or *"Hear ye! Hear ye! The witch Wyda seems to be bored. Pay her a visit but sharpen your sword. She might come up with a terrible surprise, are you brave enough to believe your eyes?"*. You can also confirm it by talking to Wyda: if she says she is bored, it is active.
2. Hand in Blood Herbs to Wyda
Get to the Venore Rotworm Cave

{npc:Wyda}'s house is in the **Green Claw Swamp**, west of Venore. Leave **Venore** through the **southwest** exit and follow the road **northwest**. About three quarters of the way to the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}, turn **north** and look for the hole to the Venore Rotworm Cave. Open the {item:Loose Stone Pile} with the {item:Shovel} and go in. In the swamp there are {creature:Snake|Snakes} and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}.
The entrance to the Venore Rotworm Cave

Go down one more floor and head **north**. Use the {item:Rope} on the next rope spot to go up and follow the path to the far **northeast** of the cave. There are 3 paths there: ignore the ramps to the **north** and the hole to the **east** and **climb the ladder**.
Cave map: yellow = start, green = rope spot
Cave map: yellow = start, green = ladder up

You come up to the surface, where there is a {creature:Wasp} and a coffin (the {item:Key 5000} from the coffin opens the house, but you do not need it). Climb another ladder and you reach {npc:Wyda}'s house, 1 floor above ground.
The ladder that leads to Wyda's area
Say {key:hi} and {key:quest}. If she says she is bored (or fed up with blood herbs), the world change is active.
Say {key:blood herb} and {key:yes} to hand over a {item:Blood Herb}. You normally get a {item:Witchesbroom}, but sometimes she gives you a {item:Torn Teddy}. Repeat with every Blood Herb you have.
Witchesbroom or, with luck, Torn Teddy + Torn Treasures achievement
While the world change is active, {creature:Giant Spider (Wyda)|fake Giant Spiders} appear around Wyda's house. Kill one to get the **Someone's Bored** achievement.

Go back the same way: climb down the two ladders to the Venore Rotworm Cave, cross the cave back (go down the rope spot hole, head **south** and go up the floor you had gone down) and leave through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope} ({coord:32699,32018,7}). Then follow the road **southeast** to the southwest exit of **Venore**.
